# Jose Maria Perez-Macias, PhD - Academic & Research Portfolio

> Biomedical & Telecommunications Engineer, Healthcare Technology Researcher, and Technical Leader. Specializing in unobtrusive sleep monitoring, contactless physiological sensors, biomedical signal processing, ballistocardiography (BCG), and 3D spatial audio. Currently affiliated with Aalto University; doctoral degree completed at Tampere University, Finland.

## Research Focus Areas

1. **Unobtrusive Sleep Monitoring & Emfit Mattress Sensors**:
   - Developing contactless algorithms for monitoring sleep architecture, physiological signals, and sleep-disordered breathing.
   - Using electro-mechanical film (Emfit) transducers embedded under bed mattresses to capture mechanical movements without attaching electrodes to patients.

2. **Snoring Detection & Classification**:
   - Time-domain, spectral analysis, and source separation (Non-negative Matrix Factorization - NMF) on mattress sensor signals.
   - Machine learning classification using Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for discriminating snoring from normal respiratory movements.

3. **Ballistocardiography (BCG) & Heart Pulse Demodulation**:
   - Demodulating heartbeat and pulse signals from mattress sensor data using tensor factorization and spectral techniques.
   - Deriving position-independent physiological signals comparable to ECG and PPG for long-term clinical monitoring.

4. **Respiratory Effort & Sleep-Disordered Breathing**:
   - Detecting increased respiratory effort, prolonged partial upper airway obstructions, and abnormal ventilation patterns in sleep apnea and pediatric patients.

5. **3D Spatial Audio & Sound Synthesis (Csound)**:
   - Head-Related Transfer Functions (HRTF), binaural synthesis, interaural time/level differences (ITD/ILD), room acoustics image source modeling, and digital signal processing opcodes in Csound.

## Doctoral Dissertation

- **Title**: *Methods for Snoring and Heart Pulse Detection Using Unobtrusive Mattress Sensor*
- **Author**: Jose Maria Perez-Macias
- **Degree**: Doctoral Dissertation, Tampere University, Faculty of Biomedical Sciences and Engineering, June 2025
- **Permanent URN**: [http://urn.fi/URN:ISBN:978-952-03-2953-7](http://urn.fi/URN:ISBN:978-952-03-2953-7)
- **Institutional Repository**: [Tampere University Trepo (Handle: 10024/227620)](https://trepo.tuni.fi/handle/10024/227620)
- **ISBN**: 978-952-03-2952-0 (print), 978-952-03-2953-7 (pdf)
- **Summary**: Investigates signal processing architectures for extracting vital physiological parameters from contactless Emfit bed mattress sensors. Establishes novel algorithms for position-independent heart pulse demodulation and machine learning models for accurate snoring event detection.
